tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List HeroX AirDomes reference documents (company and product overview, agent skill, auth/access policy) with IDs and URLs.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Return the full Markdown text of a HeroX AirDomes reference document by ID from list_docs.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search across HeroX AirDomes reference documents. Returns matching lines with their document ID. Use read_doc for full context.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List recent HeroX blog articles about air domes, fabric structures, costs and facility planning, with slugs for read_blog_post.

tools.name: read_blog_post
tools.description: Return the plain-text content of a HeroX blog article by slug from list_blog_posts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "docs-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_docs, list_blog_posts, read_blog_post · Private data: list_docs, read_doc, search_docs · Public sink: read_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_docs, list_blog_posts, read_blog_post · Private data: list_docs, read_doc, search_docs · Public sink: read_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
